purpose: 核对重点下降渠道 App 两期的净销售额、订单量、客单价、退款前销售额与退款率（金额单位分转元）
query: SELECT channel, period, SUM(net_cents)/100.0 AS net_sales, COUNT(DISTINCT order_id) AS order_count, (SUM(net_cents)/100.0)/COUNT(DISTINCT order_id) AS aov, SUM(pre_refund_cents)/100.0 AS pre_refund_sales, SUM(refund_amount_cents)/100.0 AS refund_amount, SUM(refund_amount_cents)/NULLIF(SUM(pre_refund_cents),0) AS refund_rate FROM items WHERE period IN ('control','analysis') AND channel='App' GROUP BY channel, period ORDER BY period;
